fusions.name: Clamped Mandibles
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 15 damage, stuns the target for 1.5 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Sudden Surfacing
fusions.desc: The swarm surges through a cone 3 tiles ahead of you, dealing 30 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit, and 20% of the damage dealt returns to you as healing over 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Lurking Clutch
fusions.desc: Buries a clutch of locusts at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 22 damage.

fusions.name: Mudbank Stillness
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health to you.
